authority: The shape jsonata.org documents: $formatNumber(0.14, "###pm", {"per-mille": "pm"}) => "140pm" — a multi-character scaling marker standing as the sub-picture's trailing passive text, the number scaled by the marker's factor, the marker emitted whole. Here 7 x 100 = 700, padded to the one mandatory digit, with "ab" as the suffix. (F&O 4.7.1 types "percent" as "A single character"; the documented example is what puts JSONata outside that type, and this case rests on the example rather than on F&O.)
